blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: was launched on 15th August 2023 by Prime Minister Modi as part of the Deendayal Antyodaya
NRLM under the Ministry of Rural Development. The scheme aims to empower 3 crore rural women
through skill development and micro-enterprise creation.
